title: Generate README with API docs
description: Create or update the project README with API endpoint documentation, request examples, and response formats for the backend.

Use this prompt to generate a clean, user-friendly `README.md` for the Event Management System backend.

Please include:
- project overview
- available backend API routes and HTTP methods
- request body and header examples (especially auth headers)
- expected success and error response shapes
- any authentication or role authorization requirements
- helpful usage notes for frontend integration

Analyze the backend folder and controllers to infer the API contract accurately.
